findings.note: Listed as an additional (co-)sponsor of S747, Elections Law Changes (filed 2023-06-01; became Session Law 2023-140 by veto override). Final text requires photo ID plus a proof-of-residence document to register and vote on the same day at early voting, and checks the driver license or Social Security number within two business days. It also adds a photo-ID challenge ground and allows a copy of photo ID or a residence document with a mail registration. Co-sponsor date is the filing date shown; the page does not give the date he was added.

findings.note: Roll-call transcript lists Johnson among the Ayes on the veto override of S747. The House overrode the next day and the bill became Session Law 2023-140.

Listed as an additional (co-)sponsor of S352, Remove Foreign Citizens from Voting Rolls (filed 2023-03-22). The filed bill makes United States citizenship a juror requirement and has courts share the names of people excused from jury duty for lack of citizenship with the State Board of Elections, which reviews their voter registration. Date is the filing date; the page does not give the date he was added.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Senate second reading (28-13). Johnson is listed among the Ayes.
findings.note: Legislative staff summary of Part II of the ratified bill: it requires DMV to send full Social Security numbers to the State Board of Elections monthly, requires the State Board to set a process to remove non-citizens from voter rolls using federal database information, and bars processing a registration application unless the applicant affirmatively says they are a U.S. citizen (with a sworn form if the question is left blank). The Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17. Staff summary: https://dashboard.ncleg.gov/api/Services/BillSummary/2025/H958-SMST-37(rat)-v-8
